Generate Compact HTML Table Popups (gl_popup_table)

Source: R/scales.R
gl_popup_table.Rd

Drop-in GPU-friendly replacement for leafpop::popupTable(). Formats selected columns of an sf, SpatVector, or data.frame into compact, styled HTML tables suitable for popup = gl_popup_table(df) in add_points(), add_polygons(), or add_lines().

Usage

gl_popup_table(data, zcol = NULL, row_numbers = FALSE, feature_id = FALSE)

Arguments

data

An sf, SpatVector, or data.frame object.

zcol

Optional integer or character vector of columns to include (defaults to up to 8 non-geometry columns).

row_numbers

Logical; kept for compatibility with leafpop::popupTable() (default FALSE).

feature_id

Logical; kept for compatibility with leafpop::popupTable() (default FALSE).

Value

A character vector of HTML table strings (one per row in data).
